items.message: @Polynomial.primPart : {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] → Polynomial R → Polynomial R
@Polynomial.content : {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] → Polynomial R → R
@Polynomial.IsPrimitive : {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → Polynomial R → Prop

@Polynomial.eq_C_content_mul_primPart : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R]
  (p : Polynomial R), p = Polynomial.C p.content * p.primPart

@Polynomial.content_primPart : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p.primPart.content = 1

@Polynomial.isUnit_or_eq_zero_of_isUnit_integerNormalization_primPart : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R]
  {K : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K] [inst_3 : IsFractionRing R K] [IsDomain R]
  [inst_5 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R] {p : Polynomial K},
  p ≠ 0 → IsUnit (IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) p).primPart → IsUnit p
